tools.name: who_am_i
tools.title: Get Current Bugfender User
tools.description: Returns the connected Bugfender account profile and memberships, with credentials removed.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.title: List Bugfender Apps
tools.description: Lists apps accessible to the connected Bugfender account without returning app credentials.

tools.name: get_sdk_snippet
tools.title: Get Bugfender SDK Snippet
tools.description: Generates a client-side Bugfender SDK setup snippet, including the selected app's SDK key, for a supported platform.

app_id.description: Public app ID returned by list_apps.

tools.name: get_crashes
tools.title: List Crash Groups
tools.description: Lists crash groups for an app and date range. Use list_issues when status filtering is required.

app_id.description: Public app ID returned by list_apps.

date_range_start.description: Inclusive start as an ISO 8601 datetime.

date_range_end.description: Inclusive end as an ISO 8601 datetime.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.title: List Issue Groups
tools.description: Lists issue, crash, or feedback groups for an app with status, date, content, and version filters.

app_id.description: Public app ID returned by list_apps.

date_range_start.description: Inclusive start as an ISO 8601 datetime.

date_range_end.description: Inclusive end as an ISO 8601 datetime.

content.description: Filter by issue body or content text.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.title: Get Issue Details
tools.description: Returns full details for one issue group within an optional date range.

app_id.description: Public app ID returned by list_apps.

issue_id.description: Issue group hash returned by list_issues.

date_range_start.description: Inclusive start as an ISO 8601 datetime.

date_range_end.description: Inclusive end as an ISO 8601 datetime.

tools.name: search_devices
tools.title: Search App Devices
tools.description: Searches devices observed by a Bugfender app using device, platform, version, and custom-data filters.

app_id.description: Public app ID returned by list_apps.

device_id.description: Filter by device UID or UDID.

tools.name: search_logs
tools.title: Search Bugfender Logs
tools.description: Searches an app's remote logs by text, device, time, severity, tags, or app version.

app_id.description: Public app ID returned by list_apps.

device_udid.description: Filter to a specific device by UDID.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: update_issue_status
tools.title: Update Issue Status
tools.description: Changes an issue group's status. This is a state-changing operation and requires explicit user confirmation.

app_id.description: Public app ID returned by list_apps.

issue_id.description: Issue group hash returned by list_issues or get_issue.
